# TODAY

> > Singapore's leading digital news platform covering lifestyle, health, transport, and social issues with expert commentary and in-depth features.

TODAY (todayonline.com) is a comprehensive news and lifestyle publication serving Singapore audiences with coverage spanning health and wellness, public transport systems, parenting and child development, and local community stories. The platform features expert commentary from healthcare professionals, lifestyle content through its 8days brand, and investigative features like The Big Read series.

## Key Topics

- Singapore news and lifestyle
- Health and wellness
- Workplace ergonomics and posture correction
- Public transport and buses
- Child development and parenting
- Chiropractor and medical advice
- Singapore neighborhoods (Ang Mo Kio, Toa Payoh, Chinatown)
- Commuter culture
- CNA Lifestyle content
- Musculoskeletal health
- Transport preferences and MRT
- Expert commentary
- Family wellness
- Urban living in Singapore

## Health & Wellness

- [Work could be ruining your posture – here's how to fix bad posture, according to experts](https://www.todayonline.com/8days/work-could-be-ruining-your-posture-heres-how-fix-bad-posture-according-experts-2404431): Expert advice on fixing workplace posture from Dr. Jason Ma and chiropractors, covering ergonomics, desk work health, and posture assessment techniques

## Transport & Urban Life

- [The Big Read in short: The role of buses and why some commuters love them](https://www.todayonline.com/big-read/big-read-short-role-buses-and-why-some-commuters-love-them-2321531): Feature on Singapore bus culture and commuter preferences, exploring why enthusiasts like Glenc Soh prefer buses over MRT

## Family & Parenting

- [Commentary: No kidding — respecting young children helps them grow. Here are some tips for parents, caregivers](https://www.todayonline.com/commentary/commentary-no-kidding-respecting-young-children-helps-them-grow-here-are-some-tips-parents-caregivers-2275291): Commentary on respecting children's rights per UNCRC with practical parenting tips for caregivers and families
